integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Discord status, Windows notifications and the notification area (tray).

discord.enable: Show flight as Discord status (Rich Presence)
discord.help: Shows route, aircraft type, phase and flight time, e.g. “EDDF → EGLL · A20N” and “Cruise FL360 · 420 nm to go”. No callsign in streamer mode. At most one update every 15 s; only the locally running Discord client is contacted.
discord.appIdHelp: empty = VectaSim application (default, no setup needed) · otherwise the Application ID of your own application from the Discord Developer Portal with an image asset “vectasim”
discord.appIdInvalid: The Discord app ID is a number with 17–20 digits (Developer Portal → Applications → Application ID).
discord.off: Off · Discord shows nothing from VectaSim.
discord.connected: Connected · status is set in a moment
discord.notRunning: Discord not running · VectaSim retries every 30 s.
discord.noAppId: No valid Discord app ID · the custom app ID entered is invalid. Clear the field to use the VectaSim default.
discord.noDefaultAppId: Discord status not available · this build lacks the VectaSim default app ID. A custom app ID under “Custom Discord application” still works.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.enable: Windows notifications when VectaSim is not in the foreground
notify.connection: Connection to the simulator lost / back

test.help: Without registration and callsign. Clicking the notification brings VectaSim to the front.
test.sentHint: It appears at the bottom right. If you see nothing, check Windows → Settings → System → Notifications (including “Do not disturb”).
test.failedHint: Windows rejected the notification – details in the log.

tray.title: Notification area (tray)
tray.enable: Icon in the notification area · minimizing hides the window there
tray.close: Close (X) hides VectaSim in the notification area instead of quitting
tray.help: Double-click the icon to open VectaSim again; its menu shows the recording state, switches debug mode and quits the app (“Quit”). Recording carries on in the notification area; quitting asks first during a flight.

server.title: Overlay & API
server.description: Local server for OBS browser sources, a tablet or phone on your Wi-Fi and a JSON API (live data to fetch) for virtual airlines (VAs) and your own tools – read-only, off by default.

port.label: Port
port.detail: Default {port} · allowed {min}–{max} · saves when you leave the field or press Enter, open overlays reconnect
port.notNumber: The port must be a number.

server.optionsOff: The server is off – port and LAN access take effect once you switch it on.
server.lanHelp: For a tablet, a phone or a second PC on the same network. Other devices need the token in the URL; on this PC it works without. The first time, Windows asks whether VectaSim may be reachable on the private network. Only turn this on in trusted networks.
server.noLanAddress: No network address found – is the PC connected to a network?
server.lanUrlTitle: for other devices on the network
server.obsHelp: URL extras: {scale} enlarges the text to 150 %, {preview} shows sample data for positioning. In streamer mode, registration, callsign and airline are masked here too.

hud.label: HUD
hud.hint: Phase, altitude, speed, V/S, heading, remaining, ETA

landing.label: Landing
landing.hint: 20 s after touchdown: landing rate, g, bounces, band

route.label: Route
route.hint: Route, block time, aircraft, phase bar

index.label: Start page
index.hint: all links, API overview, OBS tips

api.label: JSON status
api.hint: API for VAs and your own tools

obsSteps.title: Adding an overlay to OBS:
obsSteps.url: Copy the URL above and paste it.
obsSteps.size: Enter width and height as given (HUD 1920 × 120).

simconnect.title: Set up SimConnect
simconnect.intro: VectaSim needs Microsoft's SimConnect library. One click downloads the official MSFS SDK ({version}, {size}) directly from Microsoft and keeps only SimConnect.dll – works with MSFS 2020 and 2024.
simconnect.installerHint: The installer already offers this download during the first install; if you skipped it there, you can catch up here.
simconnect.eula: The download is subject to the {link}.
simconnect.installed: SimConnect set up – VectaSim connects automatically
simconnect.installedLater: The new file applies from the next connection.

error.running: The download is already running – please wait a moment.
error.network: Microsoft is not reachable. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.corrupt: The file arrived incomplete or modified. Try again.

simulator.label: Simulator
simulator.hostInvalid: Host name or IP only, without spaces or path
simulator.savedLater: ✓ saved · applies the next time the connection starts
simulator.xplaneHelp: X-Plane 12.1.1 or newer with the Web API enabled (default port 8086). Today X-Plane only listens locally on this PC; another host only works once X-Plane allows it. Address: {endpoint}. Saves when you leave the field or press Enter.
simulator.flightActive: A flight is in progress – the change applies after the flight.
simulator.hostTitle: Computer X-Plane runs on – for now only “localhost” (this PC)
simulator.portTitle: Port of the X-Plane Web API (default 8086). To use another port, start X-Plane with --web_server_port=…

settings.about: VectaSim {version} · Your logbook lives only on this PC – no account, no cloud. Data: map © OpenStreetMap contributors, OpenFreeMap · airports and navaids OurAirports (public domain) · weather NOAA aviationweather.gov (fallback VATSIM) · online traffic VATSIM · IVAO · flight plans SimBrief (Navigraph) · aircraft photos Planespotters.net · satellite imagery EOxCloudless 2017 by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, CC BY 4.0) · precipitation radar RainViewer · clouds EUMETSAT (contains modified Meteosat data) · country borders Natural Earth (public domain) · Thanks to npooky for the first flight test ·

sim.textLanding: Show the landing rate in the simulator (MSFS)
sim.textLandingHint: After touchdown MSFS shows a line at the top of the screen for 20 seconds, such as “VectaSim · Landed -142 fpm (smooth) · 1.18 g · no bounces · 27L: 412 m past the threshold, 1 m left”. Whether it appears depends on the MSFS version – the recording is the same either way.
sim.textTest: Send test message to the sim
sim.textTestTitle: Sends a test line to MSFS via SimConnect – to check whether your simulator shows SimConnect text at the top of the screen. Only with MSFS connected.
sim.textTestSent: ✓ sent – the sim should now show “VectaSim · test message …” at the top
sim.textTestRejected: SimConnect refused the call ({code}) – this DLL has no SimConnect_Text
sim.textTestException: The sim rejected the message ({name}, {code}) – this MSFS version does not show SimConnect text
sim.textTestNoSession: No connected MSFS session picked the message up
sim.description: VectaSim detects MSFS 2020/2024 and X-Plane 12 automatically as soon as the simulator is running. Recording starts when you taxi – you don't need to start anything.
sim.demoTitle: A simulated flight to get to know VectaSim without a simulator

dll.elsewhere: If SimConnect.dll is already somewhere else (e.g. from an SDK installation), pick it with “Choose file …”.
dll.savedLater: ✓ saved · applies from the next connection

planning.title: Flight planning
planning.description: With your SimBrief pilot ID, VectaSim loads your latest flight plan and compares plan and actual.
planning.auto: Load the latest flight plan automatically at start and when connecting
planning.noPlan: Pilot ID set · no flight plan loaded yet (Map → side panel → Dispatch)
planning.noId: No pilot ID set. You can find it on simbrief.com under Account.

updates.title: Updates
updates.recording: Recording in progress – installing restarts VectaSim. Install the update after the flight.

display.title: Display
display.description: Language, appearance, time base, weight unit, streamer mode, landing card, aircraft photos and online traffic.

language.label: Language
language.hint: System = Windows display language · applies immediately

display.weightsHint: Fuel and weights · altitudes in ft, speeds in kt

privacy.label: Streamer mode
privacy.help: Hides registrations (D-••••), callsign and flight number, airline, SimBrief ID in the whole interface and in the diagnostics package (your Windows user name in paths is always hidden there) – on the landing card and in the diagnostics package. Everything stays stored as it is; photo credits remain visible.

photos.label: Load aircraft photos from Planespotters.net
photos.help: Only the registration is sent (e.g. D-AINA), at most one request per second; photos are cached for 7 days and always show the photographer and source. Fictional registrations show a type silhouette.

globe.label: World map as a globe
globe.help: Applies to the map, the track map and Countries – the same choice as the “Globe” button on the maps. Zooming in turns the globe into the flat map by itself.

satellite.label: Satellite imagery as the base map
satellite.help: Cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaic (EOxCloudless 2017) instead of the drawn map, with place names and borders on top. Applies to the map and the track map – the same choice as the “Satellite” button. The app only loads the tiles while this is on.

online.hint: An enabled network is polled in the background every 60 s from app start, even when “Traffic” is hidden on the map – so a clicked aircraft shows up to two hours of its flown track. Traffic data is only downloaded while the network is enabled here.

theme.label: Appearance
theme.hint: Paper Chart and Arctic Studio are bright day themes – they glare in a darkened sim room. Your own aircraft stays yellow in every theme.

zoom.label: Size
zoom.hint: Ctrl+Plus/Minus, Ctrl+0 · applies to this PC only

card.pickTitle: Choose a folder for landing cards
card.autosave: Save the landing card as PNG automatically after every landing

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.caption: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.debriefHint: While the landing debrief is open, only Esc, Alt+T and zoom work – the view and logbook behind it stay as they are.

keys.list: ↑ / ↓, Page Up / Page Down, Home / End

what.panel: Collapse and expand the map's side panel
what.list: Scroll through the flights in the logbook; ↓ in the search field jumps into the list
what.enter: Open the landing debrief of the selected flight
what.delete: Move the selected flight to the trash (with confirmation)
what.arrows: Switch tabs and option groups; in the dispersion chart, from landing to landing
what.esc: Closes the innermost first: source note, then landing debrief; in the search field it clears the search
what.toast: Jump to the newest notice (toast); Esc closes it and jumps back
what.privacy: Turn streamer mode on and off (hide registrations, callsigns, IDs and paths)

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.description: For support – helps when a flight is not detected.
diag.clipboard: The clipboard is not available right now.

debug.label: Debug mode
debug.badgeTitle: Verbose log, raw dump and live raw data are on. Turn them off again after troubleshooting.
debug.help: For troubleshooting: verbose log, raw dump recording and live raw data with one switch. Stays on until you turn it off (also after a restart); then your previous settings apply again. Reproduce the problem, then “Create diagnostics package”.

package.saved: Package saved – send it to the developer
package.contents: ZIP with logs, settings, system and logbook statistics · with debug mode also raw dumps
package.contentsDebug: ZIP with logs, settings, system and logbook statistics, raw dumps (max. 200 MB) and SimConnect info

dump.record: Record raw dump (one file per simulator session, about 5–10 MB per hour)
dump.help: Records all SimConnect raw data so problems can be reproduced without a simulator. Regardless of this, VectaSim keeps the last 30 minutes in memory – “Save dump now” writes them to a file.

replay.pickTitle: Choose a raw dump for the replay
replay.description: Plays back a raw dump – for troubleshooting on the development machine.

raw.title: Live raw data
raw.description: Every simulator variable (SimConnect or X-Plane) raw and converted, events, engine state.

logLevel.debugTitle: Debug mode logs verbosely; after turning it off, this level applies again
logLevel.title: How much VectaSim writes to the log

row.dllNotFound: not found – download it with one click under Simulator or choose the file
row.dumpOn: on · {dir} (file starts with the next SimConnect session)
row.privacy: on · user name hidden in paths

data.title: Data
data.description: Where your logbook lives, how it is backed up and how you get it back.
data.blocked: Recording in progress – restore and delete are possible after the flight.

db.title: Database
db.sync: The database is in {service}. Sync services can damage an open database – put only the backups there, not the logbook itself.

backup.title: Backups
backup.dirSync: The folder is in {service} – so your backups also exist outside this PC.
backup.tip: Tip: choose a folder in OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive or on a NAS – then your backups also exist outside this PC.
backup.schedule: automatically every day, before updates and before every data format migration; the last 7 days are kept.

restore.confirm: Replace the logbook with this backup? Your current state is backed up first, then VectaSim restarts.

export.heading: Full export
export.title: Export everything
export.help: To move to another PC or to merge two PCs. The file (.vectasim) contains all flights with tracks, the fleet and your own aircraft images.

import.pickTitle: Choose a VectaSim export to import
import.mergeHelp: new flights and aircraft are added. Flights that already exist (same flight or same route less than 15 min apart at off-block) are skipped; existing aircraft data stays.
import.replaceHelp: your logbook and fleet are replaced by the file's content. VectaSim creates a backup first.

csv.heading: Import
csv.help: Bring over flights from Volanta (import CSV), SimToolkitPro, a VA export or your own logbook CSV – without track and landing analysis, but with hours, routes, fleet and countries.

trash.title: Trash
trash.retention: permanently deleted after {days} days, restore in Logbook → Trash

wipe.title: Delete all data
wipe.help: Deletes all flights and the fleet. VectaSim creates a backup first; your settings stay.
wipe.confirm: Really delete all flights and the fleet? A backup of them goes to the backup folder.
